expected_semantics.reason: wholesale_price ($204) is the standard per-pack price. case_wholesale_price ($1094 for a 6-pack case) is a bulk discount worth 10.6% off buying 6 packs individually (6 x $204 = $1224 vs $1094) — verified as a genuine SKU-specific discount, not a formatting variant of the pack price. The embedded '($182/包)' average is case_price / units_per_case, purely derived; not a fourth independent price.
expected_semantics.known_gap: case_wholesale_price's raw value is a compound string ('$1094/箱\n($182/包)'), captured verbatim as evidence. It is deliberately kept off the cost/rrp proposal path (role OTHER), so no Decimal amount is derived from it yet — not a parse failure, simply not attempted.

technical_debt.summary: case_wholesale_price is captured as raw text only on FRB-style rows (compound cell: case price plus a derived per-pack average in one string); it is not routed through money-proposal logic, so no Decimal amount exists for it yet.
needed_confirmation: Whether a structured numeric case_wholesale_price is needed downstream; if so, extend money-proposal logic with a compound-cell splitter before wiring this field to it.
